text:
arya: FYI support ticket #SUP-7125 — customer reports lots of 5xx / timeouts hitting hosted API since ~09:12 UTC. p95 spiking to 8s, multiple request_ids included.
jen-sr-support: customer says tail-timeouts on chat.generate, tokens ~5k. Getting 504s and 502s. They provided sample req id `req_0a9f3e`.
jonathan: looking at traces. I see a long queueing time before runtime acquire: kqueue depth high.
ops-oncall: ingest-bot alert triggered: continuous-batcher backlog > 1k on pool "hosted-prod-eu-3" around 09:10. Queue depth config is 1000.
ingest-bot: ALERT: batcher.backlog=1223, avg_wait_ms=5400, dequeue_errors=12
maria: probable cause = KV cache coldstart + long sequences causing batches to hit max wait and queue up. Also one tenant flooder with lots of single-token streaming calls.
jonathan: can we throttle the tenant or apply per-tenant queue limit? Any quick mitigations?
ops-oncall: immediate steps: 1) raise dequeue workers by +10 on pool, 2) temporarily lower batching window from 60ms->20ms for small-model variants, 3) add per-tenant in-flight cap for tenant "acme-app". Rolling now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/autoscale +10 to pool hosted-prod-eu-3 (change set cs_9842)
arya: customer asked for repro steps. I posted a small curl that reproduces high queueing: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat.generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"x"}' --repeat 300`
jonathan: added a quick guard in gateway: drop after queue_depth>1200 with 429 and descriptive body. Will keep for 10m.
jen-sr-support: passing that to customer, also opened escalation PRD-1342 and assigned CS follow-up.
maria: tracing shows long KV load spikes coincident with model switchovers on some hosts. Suggest patch to warm KV cache earlier and increase async prefetch. Filing task in eng-runtime.
ops-oncall: backlog dropped to 210 after worker bump and batching tweak. avg_wait_ms -> 420. Continuing monitoring. :thumbsup: 
arya: customer now sees reduced errors, p95 down to 920ms. They want post-mortem and timeline.
jonathan: logging capture saved: `host=hosted-prod-eu-3, req=req_0a9f3e, queue_ms=5600, exec_ms=120` — attaching to incident.
jen-sr-support: I'll coordinate post-mortem and share mitigations (per-tenant caps, warm-kv, monitoring alerts for queue depth).
ops-oncall: follow-ups: revert temporary drops after 30m if stable, schedule deeper investigation with runtime team.
arya: thanks everyone. tagging @maria @jonathan for follow-up tasks. :eyes:
